name: OfficeCLI Academic Paper
summary: Academic-style .docx output: journal/conference/thesis chapters with APA, Chicago, IEEE or MLA citation style, numbered equations, cross-references, footnotes and bibliography. OpenRA-adapted carry of the iOfficeAI/AionCore skill: the install section is replaced by a prerequisite check (officecli must already be installed via OpenRA's approved CLI path; the skill only verifies officecli --version) and an Apache-2.0 §4(b) modification notice is added; everything else is upstream text.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 学术风格 .docx 输出：期刊/会议/论文章节，支持 APA、Chicago、IEEE、MLA 引用格式、编号公式、交叉引用、脚注与参考文献。OpenRA 对 iOfficeAI/AionCore 技能的适配版：安装段替换为前置条件检查（officecli 须已经由 OpenRA 批准的 CLI 路径安装，技能只验证 officecli --version），并加 Apache-2.0 §4(b) 修改注记，其余为上游原文。

permissionsNote: allowed-tools declarations inside SKILL.md are upstream claims, not host approvals; OpenRA enforces its own permission gates.
